text: Shoulder.
speaker: Balag

text: Go.
speaker: Zik

text: Enhedu climbed first. Balag made a step with his hands and lifted her through. She disappeared into the rain. Ninsun followed, protecting the copied margin beneath her robe. Zik handed the lamp out and pushed the satchel ahead of him.
speaker: Narrator

text: The journal struck the leather again.
speaker: Narrator

text: Balag heard it.
speaker: Narrator

text: Get that thing out of the drain.
speaker: Balag

text: Zik climbed.
speaker: Narrator

text: Rain hit his face.
speaker: Narrator

text: He emerged behind a row of abandoned grain jars stacked against the weigh-station's rear wall. Enhedu caught his arm and pulled him clear. Balag came through last, dragging the loose bricks back into place from outside as best he could.
speaker: Narrator

text: A guard shouted within the drain.
speaker: Narrator

text: The wall bulged.
speaker: Narrator

text: Balag set one shoulder against the repaired section.
speaker: Narrator

text: We should leave.
speaker: Balag

text: They moved into the alley.
speaker: Narrator

text: Rain had thinned to a greasy mist. Water ran along the gutters in narrow gray streams. Porters clustered beneath awnings near the front of the weigh-station, complaining about delayed grain tallies and failed roof tiles. No alarm had reached them yet.
speaker: Narrator

text: Enhedu pulled her shawl over the lamp.
speaker: Narrator

text: Walk.
speaker: Enhedu

text: Balag looked at her.
speaker: Narrator

text: Not run?
speaker: Balag

text: Running tells people they should care.
speaker: Enhedu

text: A guard with a broken hand may also mention it.
speaker: Balag

text: Then look uninteresting until he does.
speaker: Enhedu

text: They crossed behind two wagons and joined the foot traffic heading toward the lower districts.
speaker: Narrator

text: Zik kept the satchel under his cloak.
speaker: Narrator

text: The journal thumped once against his ribs.
speaker: Narrator

text: He gripped the strap.
speaker: Narrator

text: Ninsun looked at the satchel.
speaker: Narrator

text: It followed us.
speaker: Ninsun

text: No one answered.
speaker: Narrator

text: They disappeared into the evening crowds.
